narrative.goal: Redesign tw-glass into a remarkably simple, cross-browser, zero-JS, native-like glass API (web-only: Chrome/Safari/Firefox).
narrative.next: Get maintainer sign-off on packages/tw-glass/REDESIGN.md, then implement the one auto-routing `glass` base + orthogonal modifiers; run the open perf pass (Q6, scripted scroll incl. iOS Safari) and grain-consistency check (Q5).
narrative.state_markdown:
- Research + empirical prototyping COMPLETE; decision-ready proposal at packages/tw-glass/REDESIGN.md (untracked). Raw log + prototype pages/captures in /tmp/glass-proto (FINDINGS.md, capture.sh, *.html, *-{chromium,safari,firefox}.png).
- PROVEN in Chromium + real Safari 18.6 + Firefox: ONE zero-JS `glass` class can auto-route — premium pure-CSS approximation baseline (frost-on-host + specular sheen + asymmetric inset rim + layered depth + baked grain) everywhere, true SVG refraction added only in Chromium via fail-safe gate `@supports (not (-webkit-hyphens:none)) and (not (-moz-appearance:none))` (TRUE Chromium / FALSE Safari+FF, verified both CSS.supports and real @supports).
- Render proof: proposed gated `.glass` is premium in Safari/FF and NEVER blank; the current refraction-only `.glass` is BLANK in Safari/FF (the regression being fixed). Premium-max recipe shows Safari can look genuinely glass-like, so refraction is a Chromium bonus not a requirement.
- Architecture results: frost MUST be on host (z-index:-1 ::before frost samples page in Safari but NOT Chromium = rejected); blur(var(--x)) works in Safari; mask-composite rim follows rounded corners (optional hero rim).
- Proposed API: ONE `glass` base + orthogonal modifiers each owning one custom property (tint/blur/saturation/brightness/bg/sheen/elevation/refract/aberration/rim-hero); refraction url() leaves the shared --tw-glass-filter slot; aberration becomes a sub-property of refraction = resolves REVIEW.md HIGH shared-slot flaw.
- Memories saved: tw-glass-redesign, chromium-css-supports-gate, cross-browser-screenshot-harness. python3 http.server :8765 still serving /tmp/glass-proto.
